subject: Request for credit note – VEN049-0014
body:
Dear Quantum Media LLP team,

We have reviewed invoice VEN049-0014 dated 1 Sep 2025. The item under HSN 8483 should attract 18 % tax, but the invoice shows no tax, resulting in a missing amount of Rs 13,774.

Please provide a credit note for Rs 13,774 or issue a corrected invoice at your earliest convenience.

Thank you.
